They can keep it, I reckon - I can't see any real benefits here.

Yeah, I was gonna make this yesterday, but whatever. Here's a quote from my dad (paraphrasing a bit, as it was some years ago):

There is one thing that no one, in this world, can ever take from you. They can take your money, they can take your house, they can take your cloths. They can take the shirt off of your back, and the pants off your legs. They can take your friends, they can take your family. Hell, they can take your fingers, and toes, if they're really freaky. But no one can ever take away your mind. What you know is yours, and no one can take that from you, so go out and learn things. Go out and know more stuff, because no one can take that from you. I don't care if you're stupid. Being stupid isn't your fault. If you're willfully ignorant, then I've got a problem with you.
